# Sonata

> Sonata is a free, offline-first web app for writing, transposing and presenting chord charts. It also includes a chord finder, circle of fifths, piano, guitar fretboard, tuner, metronome and drum pads for singers, bands, students and worship teams. No account is needed; songs stay on the user's device, with optional Google Drive backup.

Made by Jethro Frane. App: https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz

## Pages
- [Home](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/): Overview and song library.
- [Tools Hub](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/tools): Curated hub for Harmony & Reference (Chord Finder, Circle of Fifths, Key Finder) and Practice & Stage (Piano, Fretboard, Tuner, Metronome, Drum Beats & Pads).
- [Key Finder](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/tools/key-finder): Detect a song's Major or Minor key and Roman/Nashville progression from typed, tapped, or active-song chords.
- [Chord finder](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/chords): Any chord with guitar, ukulele, bass and piano diagrams, slash chords included.
- [Circle of fifths](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/theory): Explore major and minor keys (with rearranged Minor Circle ring) and the chords that belong to them.
- [Play](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/play): Piano, fretboard, tuner, metronome and drum pads for practice.
- [Piano](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/play/piano)
- [Guitar fretboard](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/play/guitar)
- [Tuner](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/play/tuner)
- [Metronome](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/play/metronome)
- [Privacy & terms](https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/privacy): What stays on the device and what Drive backup can see.

## AI Agents & MCP
- **Remote MCP Server (Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0):** `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp`
  - Anonymous callers receive 6 public music & chart tools (`extract_chords_from_url`, `analyze_chord_chart`, `build_sonata_link`, `lookup_chord`, `transpose_chart`, `get_key_info`).
  - Authenticated callers (Google Drive OAuth 2.1 + PKCE) unlock all 17 tools, including full library read/write (`get_library_summary`, `list_songs`, `get_song`, `create_song`, `import_song_from_url`, `update_song`, `trash_song`, `list_trash`, `restore_from_trash`, `empty_trash`, `manage_setlists`) synced directly to `sonata_library.json` in the user's Google Drive.
- **OAuth 2.1 Discovery & Endpoints:**
  - Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728): `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`
  - Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414): `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`
  - Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591): `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/oauth/register`
  - Authorize / Token: `/api/oauth/authorize`, `/api/oauth/token`
- **Browser WebMCP & JS Bridge:**
  - When open in a WebMCP-enabled browser (`navigator.modelContext`), Sonata registers all 17 tools automatically.
  - Browser bridge API: `window.sonataAgent` (`version`, `webMcp`, `tools()`, `call(name, args)`, `guide`).
- **Trash Safety (30-day Soft Delete):**
  - Song and setlist deletions (`trash_song`, `manage_setlists` with `action: "trash"`) move items to Trash for 30 days and are fully reversible via `restore_from_trash`.
  - `empty_trash` returns a safe preview without deleting unless `confirm: true` is explicitly supplied after user confirmation.

## Notes
- Shared songs, setlists and personal pages are private and marked noindex; please do not crawl them.
- Sitemap: https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/sitemap.xml
